# Carbon Panel

> Carbon Panel is an open-source, self-hosted control plane for running and
> managing Minecraft servers with Docker.

## What it does

- Manage Vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, and Purpur servers.
- Create and share modpacks with Modpack Studio.
- Browse and manage datapacks.
- Stage configuration, mod, datapack, file, module, and modpack updates.
- Run servers locally or across compatible remote Docker nodes.
- Use native pause, cgroup freeze, or deep sleep to reduce idle resource use.
- Operate through a web console and Connect RPC API.

## Access control

Carbon Panel supports local accounts, roles, server-scoped permissions, API
tokens, an audit log, and OIDC single sign-on (SSO). It is designed for
self-hosted installations: there is no required Carbon Cloud account, and the
operator controls the infrastructure, worlds, configuration, and database.
